notes: Only assigned unfinished fields inspected for completion; all other values are unassigned placeholders. Canonical title and authors match Van Lange et al. (1997). No PDF supplied. Older-siblings outcome is identified, but source reports a three-group omnibus F(2, 535) = 3.64 and a contrast of prosocials versus pooled individualists and competitors F(1, 535) = 4.94. Description instead specifies prosocials versus individualists in sample 2. Descriptive means do not establish a separately printed pairwise test.
